'''Dana Meimonda''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Actor/Legends|actress]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dakshee]]. After the [[Dakshee uprising|subjugation]] of her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] she and her [[Dana Meimonda's husband|husband]] escaped to [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]]. There, she entertained Imperial troops and was also a spy for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].
